name: Olympus
tagline: Plan the route before the first horn.
brief: Trials of Olympus is a five-stage rotation. Select the current Daily Trial to update the recommended epic monster and the stage-specific maximum-points table.
signals: Confirm the current Olympus stage on the calendar
Select the matching Daily Trial before opening the epic troop example
Use the recommended talents as the starting clan pattern
callout: Olympus stage names, talents, and point placeholders are editable in data/event-bonuses.json and data/olympus-points.json.

name: Ragnarök
tagline: Keep marches, timing and recalls in one rhythm.
brief: Ragnarök is a two-day rotation. Select the active Epic Monster to update the recommended shop list and the matching troop reference.
signals: Confirm whether Jormungandir or Fenrir is active
Use the matching shop recommendation before spending event currency
Keep an active army ready for defence
callout: Ragnarök monster, shop, and point placeholders are editable in data/event-bonuses.json and data/ragnarok-points.json.

name: Dark Omens
tagline: Turn scattered alerts into a clear night watch.
brief: Dark Omens is a two-day response window. Keep the clan’s march plan visible, use the reset markers below, and preserve a defensive army while points are being gathered.
signals: Open the Acronomancer troop example before sending a march
Watch R, R+7, R-8 and R-2 for the event window
Keep an active army ready for defence
callout: Dark Omens briefing data is editable in data/event-bonuses.json and data/dark-omens-points.json.
